The '''''Mandellian Gambit''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] active during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Risha Drayen]], the daughter of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nok Drayen]], was born aboard the ''Gambit''<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> in [[3664 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' gives [[Risha Drayen]]'s age during ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as 21 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, though it does not specify at what point in the game's events she is that age. However, {{TORcite|type=conversation|Early Independence|Risha Drayen}} establishes that she was 11 years old when [[Nok Drayen]] went into [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], and {{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|The Endless Abyss|the Long Shadow}}, which is the finale of Act I for the [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] class, states that Drayen was in carbonite for 10 years. As Act I occurs in 3643 BBY, simple math confirms that Risha Drayen was 21 during the events of Act I, and puts her birth in [[3664 BBY]].</ref> The ship's name recalled a famous incident early in Nok Drayen's career, where he massacred ten thousand [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandellia]].<ref name="Vault">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|The Vault|Taris}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Mandellian Gambit'' was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
